behaviors.P01: Connect the current host session; folder binding supplies the workspace
behaviors.P02: Align by task key or id with an accountable owner; server snapshot echoed verbatim
behaviors.P03: Plan from the opening request; prompt verbatim, goal and plan as typed inputs
behaviors.P04: Checkpoint before compaction, handoff and meaningful boundaries
behaviors.P05: Review the artifact category walk read-only; verdict comment only when authorized
behaviors.P06: Status and diagnostics: session, versions, liveness, receipt freshness, coverage
behaviors.P07: End: evidence floor, durable final output, final flush, readable RUN_SUMMARY, sealed session
behaviors.P08: Full product operation surface through the same CLI/core
behaviors.P09: Every typed artifact kind and provenance; binary outputs through the upload path
behaviors.P10: Observable lifecycle mapped when observed; synthesized text distinguishable
behaviors.P11: Usage and cost from provider receipts with deduplication and explicit missingness
behaviors.P12: TRACE and skeleton consent preserved independently
behaviors.P13: Resume, fork, reload, crash and offline recovery without borrowed identity
behaviors.P14: Installation and maintenance preserve unrelated resources and host trust
behaviors.P15: Complete generated instructions in every packaged entrypoint
behaviors.P16: Permanent synchronization of fixes and features across official hosts
behaviors.P17: Useful intent and handoff preservation a fresh agent can continue from
behaviors.R01: Final output: last-observed vs provisional vs explicit final; attempt identity; durable delivery; supersession
behaviors.R02: Semantic checkpoint boundaries requested by hooks, distilled by the agent, never manufactured
behaviors.R03: Structured verification receipts bound to claims by gate definition and candidate
behaviors.R04: Bounded registered-output manifests; uncommitted and binary outputs preserved distinctly
behaviors.R05: Typed common event fields with provider extensions; explicit coverage classes
behaviors.R06: Skeleton cmd/command and absolute paths; exact overflow accounting; checkpoint indexing
behaviors.R07: Declared truncation with original/retained sizes and recoverable references
behaviors.R08: Versioned per-kind semantic schema rendered to Markdown; outcome-first summary; recall excludes superseded
